40501.commentary: (VINa) paṭinissajjantassā'ti ñattito pubbe vā ñattikkhaṇe vā ñattipariyosāne vā paṭhamāya vā anusāvanāya dutiyāya vā tatiyāya vā yāva yya-kāraṃ na sampāpuṇāti, tāva paṭinissajjantassa saṅgh'ādisesena anāpatti.

examples.text: anāpatti asamanubhāsantassa, paṭinissajjantassa, ummattakassa, khittacittassa, vedan'āṭṭassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

40503.meaning1: to give up; to relinquish; to drop; to abandon
40503.meaning2: to give up; to abandon; to drop

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi bhavaṃ kassapo evam'āha, atha kho n'ev'āhaṃ sakkomi idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjituṃ.

40504.meaning2: having given up, having renounced, having forsaken

40506.synonym: catta, jahita, paccakkhāta, pariccatta, pahīna, bāhita, vijahita, vitiṇṇa, vippahīna, vossaṭṭha

examples.text: kathañ'ca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti. idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.
yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, ye keci sattā saccam'anugāyanti jalitapajjalita-mahāaggikkhandho paṭinivattatū'ti, tesaṃ saha saccam'anugītena jalitapajjalita-mahāaggikkhandho khaṇena paṭinivattati.
mataṃ me jīvitā seyyaṃ, tasmā araññaṃ pavisitvā ubbandhitvā marissāmī'ti araññaṃ gato maraṇabhayatajjito paṭinivatti.

40510.meaning2: should be returned; should come back

40511.meaning2: to return to; to turn back to

40512.meaning1: having turned around and come back (from)

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo bhagavantaṃ anusaṃyāyitvā tato paṭinivattitvā
atha kho āyasmā rāhulo, ko n'ajja bhagavatā sammukhā ovādena ovadito gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisissatī'ti tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi

40513.meaningLit: having caused to proceed back down

examples.text: na kammaṭṭhānavippayuttena cittena pādaṃ uddharati. uddharati ce, paṭinivattetvā purimapadesaṃ y'eva eti āḷindakavāsī mahāphussadevatthero viya.
abhirama, mahārāja, devesu dev'ānubhāvenā'ti. alaṃ, mārisa, tatth'eva maṃ mithilaṃ paṭinetu.
evaṃ, bhaddantavā'ti kho, ānanda, mātali saṅgāhako sakkassa devānam'indassa paṭissutvā sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā nimiṃ rājānaṃ tatth'eva mithilaṃ paṭinesi.

40518.meaning1: contrary; opposed; opposite; in opposition to

40521.meaning1: follows a path; undertakes a journey; travels

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ek'addhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gām'antaram'pi aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dve jāyam'patikā parittaṃ sambalaṃ ādāya kantāramaggaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ

40522.meaning1: practices; follows a course of action; follows a method

examples.text: hitvā icchañ'ca lobhañ'ca, yattha satto puthujjano, cakkhumā paṭipajjeyya, tareyya narakaṃ imaṃ.
tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ, yā samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā taṃ paṭipajjissāma.

40523.meaning2: enters upon a course, follows a method

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, puriso yācitakaṃ bhogaṃ yācitvā yānaṃ vā poriseyyaṃ pavaramaṇikuṇḍalaṃ. so tehi yācitakehi bhogehi purakkhato parivuto antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyya.

40525.meaning1: following a path; undertaking a journey; travelling
40525.meaning2: following a path; undertaking a journey; travelling

examples.text: ayañ'hi piṇḍapātapaṭisevanapaccayā kāyabalaṃ nissāya sikkhattay'ānuyogavasena bhavakantāranittharaṇ'atthaṃ paṭipajjanto brahmacariy'ānuggahāya paṭisevati, kantāranittharaṇ'atthikā puttamaṃsaṃ (saṃ. ni. 2.63) viya, nadīnittharaṇ'atthikā kullaṃ (ma. ni. 1.240) viya, samuddanittharaṇ'atthikā nāvam'iva ca.

40526.meaning1: practising; following a course of training
40526.meaning2: entering upon a path or course, going along, following a method
40526.commentary: (DNa) yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno'ti yathā mayā anusiṭṭhaṃ anusāsanī dinnā, tathā paṭipajjamāno.

examples.text: yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati sattavassāni.

40529.meaning1: followed a path; took a road; undertook a journey; travelled
40529.meaning2: entered upon a path or course, went along

examples.text: ahaṃ kho pubbe sadhano sabhogo kantār'addhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjiṃ

40530.meaning1: practised; followed a course of action; followed a method
40530.meaning2: entered upon a course, followed a method

examples.text: atha kho maṃ, aggivessana, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ, mā kho tvaṃ, mārisa, sabbaso āhār'upacchedāya paṭipajji.

40531.meaning1: should be practised; should be followed; should be undergone

examples.text: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.
kathaṃ nu kho amhehi paṭipajjitabban'ti? bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.

40532.meaning2: you want to follow; you want to go down

40533.meaning1: to follow; to go along; to undertake; to practise
40533.commentary: (THa) evaṃ pahomi maggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ sivan'ti asivabhāvakarānaṃ kilesānaṃ abhāvena sivaṃ. cittānurakkhīhī'ti attano cittaṃ anurakkhaṇasīlehi buddh'ādīhi sabbakālaṃ sevitaṃ ariyamaggaṃ ahaṃ paṭipajjituṃ adhigantuṃ pahomi sakkomī'ti.

examples.text: tayā sudantena avaṭṭhitena hi, hayena yogg'ācariyo'va ujjunā, pahomi maggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ sivaṃ, citt'ānurakkhīhi sadā nisevitaṃ.

40534.meaning1: having practised; having followed a course of action; having followed a method
40534.meaning2: having entered upon a path or course, having gone along, having followed a method

examples.text: upāyakusalen'āhaṃ, buddhen'ādiccabandhunā, yoniso paṭipajjitvā, bhave cittaṃ udabbahin'ti.
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ ābādhaṃ vīriyena paṭipaṇāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāraṃ adhiṭṭhāya vihareyyan'ti. atha kho bhagavā taṃ ābādhaṃ vīriyena paṭipaṇāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāraṃ adhiṭṭhāya vihāsi.
asussūsā aparipucchā paññāya paripantho, ananuyogo apaccavekkhaṇā dhammānaṃ paripantho, micchāpaṭipatti saggānaṃ paripantho

paṭipadāya na saṇṭhātī'ti paṭipattiyaṃ na tiṭṭhati, vattaṃ ajānitvā apucchitabbaṭṭhāne pucchatī'ti attho. ayaṃ pañho nāma cetiy'aṅgaṇe pucchitena na kathetabbo, tathā bhikkhācāramagge gāmaṃ piṇḍāya caraṇakāle.

40538.synonym: apadāna, ākappa, ācāra, iriyā, caraṇa, cariya, cariyā, cāra, cāritta, vutti, samācāra

examples.text: dasame gihisāmīcipaṭipadan'ti gihīnaṃ anucchavikaṃ paṭipattiṃ.

40541.meaning2: founded on practice; based on practice

40543.meaning2: Chapter 4 of the Maggasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: dvīhatīhapayāto kho pana so sattho addasa purisaṃ kāḷaṃ lohit'akkhaṃ sannaddhakalāpaṃ kumudamāliṃ allavatthaṃ allakesaṃ kaddamamakkhitehi cakkehi bhadrena rathena paṭipathaṃ āgacchantaṃ, disvā etadavoca, kuto, bho, āgacchasī'ti? amukamhā janapadā'ti.
anāpatti ārāme ṭhito passati, bhikkhussa ṭhit'okāsaṃ vā nisinn'okāsaṃ vā nipann'okāsaṃ vā āgacchati, paṭipathaṃ gacchanto passati, tathārūpappaccayā, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

40545.meaning1: way; path of progress; path of practice

examples.text: tattha yo tiṇṇaṃ akusalamūlānaṃ nirodho, ayaṃ nirodho. so'y'eva maggo tattha paṭipadāni imāni dve saccāni imāni cattāri saccāni āvaṭṭo hāro.

40546.meaning1: who is walking the path; who is practising the path; going along
40546.meaning2: who is walking the path; who is practising the path; going along

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā kāpilavatthave sakye bahu'd'eva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, paṭibhātu taṃ, ānanda, kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ sekho paṭipado. piṭṭhi me āgilāyati, tam'ahaṃ āyamissāmī'ti.

40547.meaning1: who has reached the end of the path of practice
40547.commentary: (ANa) dhīraṃ paṭipad'antagun'ti khandhadhīra-āyatanadhīra-vasena dhīraṃ dhitisampannaṃ paṭipattiyā antaṃ gataṃ.

examples.text: tam'āhu sekhaṃ paṭipadaṃ, atho saṃsuddhacāriyaṃ, tam'āhu loke sambuddhaṃ, dhīraṃ paṭipad'antaguṃ.

40548.meaning1: way; path of progress; mode of practice; method of implementation

examples.text: ucc'āvacā hi paṭipadā, samaṇena pakāsitā, na pāraṃ diguṇaṃ yanti, na'y'idaṃ ekaguṇaṃ mutaṃ.
akittayī vivaṭacakkhu, sakkhidhammaṃ parissayavinayaṃ, paṭipadaṃ vadehi bhaddante, pātimokkhaṃ athavā'pi samādhiṃ.

40549.meaning1: (in debate) procedure; mode of conduct; rules of engagement
40549.commentary: (ANa) paṭipadāya saṇṭhātī'ti gehe nisīdāpetvā yāgukhajjak'ādīni datvā yāva bhattaṃ niṭṭhāti, tasmiṃ antare nisinno pañhaṃ pucchati. sappi'ādīni bhesajjāni aṭṭhavidhāni pānakāni vatthacchādanamālāgandh'ādīni vā ādāya vihāraṃ gantvā tāni datvā divāṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā okāsaṃ kāretvā pañhaṃ pucchati. evañ'hi vattaṃ ñatvā pucchanto paṭipadāya saṇṭhāti nāma.

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhāti parikappe na saṇṭhāti aññātavāde na saṇṭhāti paṭipadāya na saṇṭhāti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

40551.meaning1: for the sake of purity of understanding and insight into the path of practice; for the purpose of purification of knowledge and vision of the way

examples.text: kiṃ pan'āvuso, paṭipadā-ñāṇadassana-visuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
evam'eva kho, āvuso… kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi yāva'd'eva magg'āmagga-ñāṇadassana-visuddh'atthā, magg'āmagga-ñāṇadassanavisuddhi yāva'd'eva paṭipadā-ñāṇadassana-visuddh'atthā

40552.meaning1: purity of understanding and insight into the path of practice; purification of knowledge and vision of the way

examples.text: kiṃ pan'āvuso, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
kiṃ pan'āvuso, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi anupādāparinibbānan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

40553.meaning1: teaching about the path of practice

40554.meaning1: excellency of path; best kind of practice

40556.meaningLit: discourse on the path of practice

40559.meaning1: followed a path; undertaken a journey
40559.meaning2: entered upon a path or course, gone along

examples.text: etañ'hi tumhe paṭipannā, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatha, akkhāto vo mayā maggo, aññāya sallakantanaṃ.

namo te buddha vīr'atthu, vippamutto'si sabbadhi, sambādhapaṭipanno'smi, tassa me saraṇaṃ bhavā'ti.

40561.meaning2: who has entered on the way

40564.meaning1: having turned around; having spun around

examples.text: so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ bhoge vā naṅguṭṭhe vā gaṇheyya. tassa so alagaddo paṭiparivattitvā hatthe vā bāhāya vā aññatarasmiṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅge ḍaṃseyya.

40565.meaning1: sees; sees within oneself; sees internally (that)

examples.text: dukkhan'ti khandhe paṭipassa yoniso, yato ca dukkhaṃ samudeti taṃ jaha, idh'eva dukkhassa karohi antaṃ, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
